method: Walk-forward split: train 2007-2015 (threshold matching only), test 2016-2026. Three crash-proxy labels; ROC AUC reported as the primary metric.
interpretation: CRI v2 calibration changes are within statistical noise of v1 on the headline 5%-in-20d drawdown target (AUC 0.621 vs 0.620). On that target, a naive VIX-percentile baseline (0.637) matches or beats CRI — VIX alone carries most of the signal. CRI's edge surfaces on the larger 10%-in-60d target, where v1 (0.647) outperforms the baseline (0.629). Read CRI as a structured, decomposable regime monitor — not a strict drawdown predictor.
